run_update_compatibility_version: run the script to update LAST_RELEASED version in tests.sh with a new MAJOR.MINOR.MICRO version
run_RewriteTextFile: run RewriteTextFile to rewrite a text file line by line using a custom line rewriter function
run_ReplaceVersion: run ReplaceVersion to replace the LAST_RELEASED value in a line with a new version string
refactor_RewriteTextFile: refactor RewriteTextFile to use context managers for safer file handling instead of manual open and close
review_ReplaceVersion: review ReplaceVersion to verify the regex pattern correctly matches and replaces LAST_RELEASED version strings
